MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Ring doorbell feels useful because seeing visitors at the door adds a specific capability alongside my existing security cameras.",
    "The Echo Show fits my Fire TV and camera setup while adding a screen for convenient controls and viewing compatible camera feeds."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "More Fire TV sticks repeat a function I already have covered, and the HD versions offer little benefit alongside my 4K devices.",
    "The hard drive, SSD enclosure and USB adapters address storage or connection needs I do not currently have. Owning electronics does not make those accessories useful to me now.",
    "The Echo Studio and lighting bundle add a larger speaker and smart lighting that I am not currently seeking; the Echo Show's screen gives me a clearer reason to choose it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to recommend more streaming devices, even though those purchases already meet that need.",
    "My interest in connected devices seems to have been stretched into interest in any Alexa product or computer accessory, regardless of what it would help me do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more interested in adding a useful capability to my existing setup than buying another device that does the same job.",
    "The specific function matters: a doorbell helps me see visitors, and a small display could help me check compatible cameras. Extra storage, lighting or audio equipment needs its own practical reason."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in streaming and home security but missed how much my choices depend on adding a useful capability to equipment I already own."
}
